env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd foreign
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/foreign$GOEXE ./cmd
exec $WORK/bin/foreign$GOEXE
stdout '^foreign-ok$'
logos run ./cmd
stdout '^foreign-ok$'
logos eject -o eject
exists eject/go.mod
cd eject
go build ./lib ./cmd
go run ./cmd
stdout '^foreign-ok$'
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run ./cmd
stdout '^foreign-ok$'
cd ../..

-- foreign/go.mod --
module example.com/foreign

go 1.27

-- foreign/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Blank = struct {
	N int
	_ int
}

type Refd = struct {
	N   int
	ref *int
}

type Key struct {
	N int
}

func NewBlank(n, hidden int) Blank {
	return Blank{n, hidden}
}

func NewRefd(n, ref int) Refd {
	p := ref
	return Refd{n, &p}
}

func BlankMap() map[Blank]int {
	return map[Blank]int{
		NewBlank(2, 9): 20,
		NewBlank(0, 7): 0,
		NewBlank(1, 8): 10,
	}
}

func RefdMap() map[Refd]int {
	return map[Refd]int{
		NewRefd(3, 300): 3,
		NewRefd(1, 100): 1,
		NewRefd(2, 200): 2,
	}
}

func KeyMap() map[Key]int {
	return map[Key]int{
		Key{N: 2}: 20,
		Key{N: 0}: 0,
		Key{N: 1}: 10,
	}
}

-- foreign/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/foreign/lib"
)

func blankKeys(m const map[lib.Blank]int) string {
	s := ""
	for k, v := range m {
		s += fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d|", k.N, v)
	}
	return s
}

func refdKeys(m const map[lib.Refd]int) string {
	s := ""
	for k, v := range m {
		s += fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d|", k.N, v)
	}
	return s
}

func keyKeys(m const map[lib.Key]int) string {
	s := ""
	for k, v := range m {
		s += fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d|", k.N, v)
	}
	return s
}

func qualShadowKeys(m const map[lib.Key]int) string {
	lib := 3
	s := ""
	for k, v := range m {
		s += fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d|", k.N, v)
	}
	_ = lib
	return s
}

func main() {
	if got, want := blankKeys(lib.BlankMap()), "0:0|1:10|2:20|"; got != want {
		fmt.Println("blank-bad", got)
		return
	}
	if got, want := refdKeys(lib.RefdMap()), "1:1|2:2|3:3|"; got != want {
		fmt.Println("refd-bad", got)
		return
	}
	if got, want := keyKeys(lib.KeyMap()), "0:0|1:10|2:20|"; got != want {
		fmt.Println("key-bad", got)
		return
	}
	if got, want := qualShadowKeys(lib.KeyMap()), "0:0|1:10|2:20|"; got != want {
		fmt.Println("qual-bad", got)
		return
	}
	if got, want := blankKeys(map[lib.Blank]int{lib.Blank{N: 2}: 20, lib.Blank{N: 0}: 0, lib.Blank{N: 1}: 10}), "0:0|1:10|2:20|"; got != want {
		fmt.Println("mainlit-bad", got)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("foreign-ok")
}
